summary: This Qantas Group page describes its carbon offsetting program, which invests in offset projects that reduce emissions and often bring community and environmental benefits in Australia and overseas. It covers the company's offsets focus and integrity framework, the Fly Carbon Neutral customer program with dollar-for-dollar matching, the Qantas Future Planet corporate offsetting program, and the Australia Post partnership that made parcel delivery carbon neutral in September 2019.
one_line: Qantas Group's carbon offsetting programs, including Fly Carbon Neutral, Qantas Future Planet, and the Australia Post partnership.
key_facts: The Qantas Group has invested in carbon offset projects since 2007.
Aviation is described as a hard-to-abate sector, and high-integrity carbon offsets will play an ongoing part until alternate direct emissions reduction levers become more readily available.
In FY23, Qantas procured offsets from Arnhem Land Fire Abatement (ALFA), an Aboriginal owned, not-for-profit carbon farming business.
ALFA generates Australian Carbon Credit Units through savanna burning methodology.

Qantas's Integrity Framework includes purchasing from verified registries, due diligence/assurance from suppliers, ongoing monitoring and reporting, Investment Principles, and a Project Evaluation Framework.
Qantas matches dollar-for-dollar every customer contribution to offset emissions on a passenger flight under the Fly Carbon Neutral (FCN) program, effectively doubling the program's size.
Frequent Flyer members and Qantas Business Rewards customers can earn 10 Qantas Points for every A$1 spent on offsetting.
Through the Future Planet program, Qantas has offset emissions for more than 40 businesses, including Australia Post, Allens, DHL, NextDC, and T2.
Qantas Future Planet provides a carbon-offsetting solution for corporate businesses to offset operational or unavoidable emissions.
In September 2019, Australia Post implemented carbon neutral delivery of every parcel sent through Post Offices and the MyPost system across Australia.
The Australia Post carbon neutral delivery was made possible through its partnership with the Qantas Future Planet program.
Qantas Frequent Flyer points contributions are not matched; only cash contributions from Qantas and Jetstar passengers are matched.
